Because "Al Noor" (meaning "The Light" in Arabic) is a very common name used for numerous businesses, schools, hospitals, and groups worldwide,
ownership depends on the specific entity you mean
Prominent Entities Named Al Noor
Al-Noor Meat Export Plant
(India):
Owned by
Sunil Sood
and
Ajay Sood
Al-Noor Hospitals Group
(Abu Dhabi):
Formerly operated and led by
Dr. Kassem Alom
and
Sheikh Mohammed Bin Butti
before being acquired by Mediclinic International.
Al-Noor Group / Al-Noor Sugar Mills (Pakistan):
A prominent industrial conglomerate managed under the Ismail family / Al-Noor corporate umbrella.
Al-Noor FC
(Saudi Arabia):
A football club founded by
Najim Hameed Alkhamis
and chaired by
Abdullah Al Darwish
Al-Noor Medica
(Pakistan):
Established by the late
Dr. Dildar Ahmed Chaudhary
